name: Marcus Webb
application_text: I came into sales through a customer-support desk, which is where I learned that most people who say no are really saying not yet. Most of my week is cold outreach. I book between fifteen and twenty discovery calls a week from cold lists, and I hand every qualified one to a closer with notes on what the prospect said, what they objected to and what they seemed to want. I keep my own tracking sheet because the CRM never quite matches how I work. I have never run the money conversation myself and I am not trying to; I like the front of the funnel and I am good at it. Available from the first of next month, remote or hybrid.

name: Priya Raghunathan
application_text: Eight years in high-ticket coaching sales, the last three of them fully remote. I take over once a call is booked. I run the closing call and take payment on the call itself, and last year I carried a personal quota of 1.2M with a 31 percent close rate on qualified opportunities. I do not prospect and I am not interested in roles where closers are expected to fill their own calendar; that is a different job. What I bring is the conversation at the end - handling the objection about money, the objection about time, and the one about the spouse. References from two previous programme owners available on request.

name: Daniel Okafor
application_text: Former client, then head coach. My work starts after the sale, and I think that is where the reputation of a programme is actually made. I deliver the twelve-week onboarding programme to clients one to one, and I run the weekly accountability calls that keep them from churning in month two. I have done this for cohorts of forty and for one-to-one premium tiers, and I am comfortable with both. I do not sell, and I would rather not be on sales calls even as the 'meet your coach' guest. Looking for a programme that treats delivery as the product rather than as the thing that happens after the product is sold.

name: Sofia Lindqvist
application_text: I have run my own coaching offer for four years and I am looking to fold it into a larger operation. I work the whole funnel alone. I source my own leads, book them, close them and then onboard them, which means I am prospecting on Monday and taking payment on Friday without handing anyone off. That has kept my numbers honest but it does not scale, and I would rather bring the whole loop to a team than keep doing all of it myself. I am equally happy in any single part of it, but the truth is I am strongest when I own the outcome end to end. Open to commission-heavy structures.
